findings.comment: Utility plan shows water, wastewater, storm drain, and electric utilities routed together through the central driveway corridor rather than separated by type (wet utilities on one side, dry utilities on the other) for safety and maintenance access purposes. Wet and dry utilities must be properly grouped and alternated.

Preliminary Electrical Design Plan shows electrical meters located on all eight buildings but does not depict electrical disconnects, service disconnects, or main breakers. Cannot verify that meter and disconnect are within 20 feet of each other or maintain required sight-line relationship. Electrical disconnects must be shown and located on the site plan.

Site plan shows underground electric routing in proximity to building foundations, with conductor lines running along building perimeters and connecting to meters. However, specific horizontal clearance distances from building foundations to electric facilities are not documented or dimensioned on the plans. Measurable clearances to confirm minimum 5-foot separation from foundations must be provided.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls - perimeter and detention pond
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown throughout the site (perimeter and detention pond). Electric utility routing is depicted on site plan. However, specific horizontal clearance distances between retaining wall locations and underground electric duct banks are not documented or dimensioned. Minimum 5-foot clearances from all permanent structures to duct banks must be verified and shown.

Storm drain inlets are shown on the site plan and electric facility routing is indicated on the electrical design plan. However, specific horizontal clearance distances between proposed drain inlet locations and underground electric facilities are not documented. Clearance distances must be verified and dimensioned on the plans.

applicableAreas: Pull box location - left side of site near Building 1
findings.comment: Electrical pull box is shown on the preliminary electrical design plan in the area near Building 1. However, the plan does not verify that the pull box is located inside the property line, nor are clearance distances from all sides documented. Specific location within property boundary and 5-foot clearances from adjacent features must be verified.

Site plans show proposed water and electric utility lines crossing through the central driveway corridor. The utility notes state 'Contractor shall verify horizontal and vertical location of existing utilities prior to construction' but do not provide designer-documented clearance distances between electric conduit and water lines at crossing points. Minimum 12-inch horizontal clearance must be verified and dimensioned on the plans.

Site plans show proposed wastewater and electric utility lines routing through central driveway. Specific horizontal clearance distances at perpendicular crossing points are not documented. Minimum 12-inch horizontal clearance between electric conduit and wastewater lines must be verified and shown on plans.

applicableAreas: Utility corridor - central driveway and building perimeters
findings.comment: Site plans show multiple utility types (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric, communications) routing through similar corridors. Specific horizontal clearance distances between electric conduit and other utilities are not documented at crossing points. Minimum 12-inch horizontal clearance must be verified and dimensioned on plans.

Utility profile shown for water line on Sheet 20 documents water pipe depths (FL 8" = 674.33', FL 6" = 674.42'). However, depths of underground electric facilities are not shown on profiles, and vertical clearance calculations between water/wastewater lines and electric facilities at crossing points are not documented. Minimum 12-inch vertical clearance must be verified and dimensioned on utility profile sheets.

applicableAreas: Property perimeter - Valley View Road side and other boundaries
findings.comment: Overhead electric (OHE) lines are shown on the property perimeter on the electrical design plan. Proposed underground utilities (water, wastewater, electric) are routed on the site. However, no profile sheets or documentation show the clearance between overhead conductor heights and underground utility burial depths. Vertical clearance distances must be verified to ensure adequate protection from overhead lines.

applicableAreas: Property boundary - adjacent to Valley View Road
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are shown on the Valley View Road adjacent property boundary. Proposed underground electric is routed on the subject property. However, specific horizontal separation distances between overhead electric on adjacent property and proposed underground electric lines on this property are not documented. Minimum 10-foot separation must be verified and dimensioned.

applicableAreas: Utility corridor - central driveway and building areas
findings.comment: Utility plans show water, wastewater, electric, and communications utilities routed through similar corridors throughout the site. Specific horizontal trench separation distances between Austin Water infrastructure (water/wastewater) and non-Austin Water utilities (electric, communications) are not documented. Minimum 5-foot horizontal separation (or 3-foot for residential service lines) must be verified and noted on utility coordination plans.

Electric utility routing is shown on the site plan and electrical design plan. However, no utility profile sheets document the cover depth of underground electric facilities over finished grade. Confirmation that duct banks maintain minimum 36-inch cover depth (or documentation of new duct bank installation to achieve required depth) must be provided on utility profile sheets.

Overhead electric (OHE) lines are shown on the property perimeter. Building locations are shown on the site plan. However, specific sky-to-ground clearance distances from proposed building features (7.5 feet minimum from overhead primary/neutral/secondary conductors, 15-foot radial clearance from distribution primary/neutral) are not calculated or documented. Building elevations and clearance calculations must be provided.

Electrical design plan shows underground electric conduit routing in proximity to building footprints, with meter connections requiring lines to cross building footprint edges. Foundation plans show slab-on-grade construction. However, explicit coordination verification that building foundations do not extend over underground electric facilities, and specific clearance distances, are not documented. Formal coordination and clearance verification must be provided.

Utility plans show communication conduit routing on site (indicated in legend and routing). Electric facilities including main line routing are also shown. However, plans do not explicitly document or confirm that communication conduits do not cross over Austin Energy main line duct banks. Verification and spatial documentation of communication conduit clearance from main line duct banks must be provided.

Utility crossing locations shown on site plans and profiles. However, no encasement details, AE Design coordination letters, or specifications requiring 2-inch concrete encasement extending minimum 24 inches on either side of electric facility crossings are documented on the plans. Coordination with Austin Energy Design and encasement requirements must be established and detailed.

Retaining walls are detailed on wall plans (Sheets 38-39) and electric utilities are routed on site plan (Sheet 21). However, if electric conduit passes through retaining walls below grade, the required conditions are not documented: (1) license agreement with AE, (2) metal sleeve of sufficient size for conduit replacement, (3) perpendicular passage with 1-inch extension past wall/footing, and (4) engineering drawings sealed by Professional Engineer. Conduit-through-wall details and licensing must be provided if applicable.

applicableAreas: Utility vault location - public area near Valley View Road
findings.comment: Utility vault is shown on Sheet 20 (Fire Demand Meter in 8' x 12' Vault per Detail 512-AW-02). Vault location depicted on plan. However, specific documentation verifying that a 5-foot exclusive space is maintained around and under the vault structure, and that no other utilities or structures encroach within this zone, is not provided. Detailed verification with dimensions must be shown on utility coordination plans.

Electrical meters are shown on exterior walls of all eight buildings on the electrical design plan. However, building elevation drawings showing detailed meter placement relative to porches, stairways, overhangs (exceeding 72 inches), carports, and other obstructions are not provided with the site plan. Building elevation documentation showing meter locations must be submitted to verify compliance.

applicableAreas: Electrical meters and transformers - all buildings
findings.comment: Electrical design plan shows meter locations on each building and four transformer pad locations. However, building elevations confirming that all meters are located on first floor or ground level are not provided. Additionally, sight-line verification between each meter and its serving transformer is not documented on the plan. Detailed documentation with floor elevations and sight-line confirmation must be provided.

applicableAreas: Building service areas - all units if individual meters proposed
findings.comment: Electrical design plan shows proposed electric meters but no gas meter locations are documented on the site plan for individual units. One existing gas meter is shown off-site. If individual gas meters are proposed for each unit or building, their locations relative to electric meters (minimum 3-foot separation required) must be documented. Building-level details are needed to verify compliance.
